title: gdpr.section.erased
description: This module's receipt for one erasure: what it removed for the named subject, echoing the correlation_id it was asked with. Emitted in the same transaction as the deletions (outbox discipline), so a rolled-back erasure never produces a receipt.

counts.description: Rows removed, by kind. Account: memberships, invitations_sent, invitations_anonymized, provision_operations_anonymized, workspaces_soft_deleted. Workspace: memberships, invitations, mfa_enforcements, provision_operations, workspaces.
